Creator Badge

Add the official STLACCESS verification to your store descriptions. Give your customers the confidence that your models are tested against widely-used gaming scales.

Installation Tip

Paste the generated HTML into your "Product Description" or "About the Artist" section. The badge is fully responsive and automatically links to the STLACCESS Conversion Library so your customers can verify the math themselves.
